events.title: The Future of Exam Prep: AI Revolution
events.address: Universiteler Mah. 1604. Cad. No: 9, Cankaya, Ankara
events.description: Join us for the launch of the 'Tesla of Exam Prep'. Discover how Auto-Learning technology is replacing traditional tutoring for IELTS and SAT.
events.fullDescription:
The future of education is not about working harder, but working smarter with data. In this launch event, we unveil Study Score AI's core technology:

- Demonstration of the 'Smart Tutor' engine
- Real-time analysis of student performance data
- The difference between generic LLMs and our Fine-Tuned Exam Models
- Success stories from our pilot program

Perfect for students, parents, and educators who want to see the cutting edge of EdTech.
content: Q&A on the future of AI in education

faqs.question: Is this event for students or investors?
faqs.answer: Both! We welcome students looking for better exam prep and investors interested in the next unicorn of EdTech.

faqs.question: Will there be a recording?
faqs.answer: Yes, the keynote will be streamed live on our social media channels.

faqs.question: Can I try the AI during the event?
faqs.answer: Yes, we will have demo stations set up for hands-on experience with the platform.

faqs.question: Is food provided?
faqs.answer: Light refreshments and coffee will be served during the networking hour.

events.title: Mastering IELTS with Your Personal AI Tutor
events.address: Universiteler Mah. 1604. Cad. No: 9, Cankaya, Ankara
events.description: Stuck at Band 6.5? Bring your laptop and let our AI analyze your writing and speaking in real-time. A hands-on workshop for immediate improvement.
events.fullDescription:
This is not a lecture; it is a working session. Participants will use Study Score AI to tackle real IELTS tasks.

Highlights:

- Instant feedback on Writing Task 2 essays
- AI analysis of Speaking pronunciation and fluency
- Identifying your specific 'score killer' mistakes
- Creating a personalized study roadmap for the next 30 days
- Tips on time management during the exam
content: Hands-on practice with the AI platform
Personalized weakness report for every attendee
Strategies to jump from Band 6.5 to 7.5+

faqs.question: Do I need to bring a laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, please bring a laptop or tablet to access the platform during the workshop.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: It is best suited for students who have started preparing but want to boost their scores, but beginners are welcome too.

faqs.question: What is the cost?
faqs.answer: There is a small registration fee of $15 to cover materials and refreshments.

faqs.question: Will I get my results immediately?
faqs.answer: Yes, the AI provides instant feedback on your tasks during the session.

participants.name: Elif Demir
participants.bio: Elif has helped over 500 students achieve Band 7+ and now trains our AI to think like an examiner.

events.title: SAT & TOEFL Strategy Summit
events.address: Universiteler Mah. 1604. Cad. No: 9, Cankaya, Ankara
events.description: Targeting Ivy League? Learn how to optimize your SAT and TOEFL prep to reach the top 1% of scorers using data-driven strategies.
events.fullDescription:
High scores are the gatekeepers to top US universities. This summit focuses on the strategic aspect of test-taking.

Agenda:

- Decoding the Digital SAT format
- How to use AI to predict question patterns
- TOEFL vs. IELTS: Which one should you take?
- Building a competitive application profile
- Alumni panel: How they got into Harvard and MIT
content: Deep dive into Digital SAT algorithms
Guest speakers from top counseling firms

faqs.question: Is this relevant for the paper-based SAT?
faqs.answer: No, we focus entirely on the new Digital SAT format as that is the current standard.

faqs.question: Can parents attend?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a specific session dedicated to parents on how to support the application process.

faqs.question: Is lunch included?
faqs.answer: Yes, a buffet lunch is included in the ticket price.

events.title: Cracking the Code: Cognitive Load Theory in AI
events.address: Universiteler Mah. 1604. Cad. No: 9, Cankaya, Ankara
events.description: Understanding the science behind efficient learning. How we use Cognitive Load Theory to prevent burnout and maximize retention.
events.fullDescription:
Why do students burn out? Often, it's because information is presented poorly. Study Score AI uses Cognitive Load Theory to manage the difficulty of questions dynamically.

We will discuss:

- Intrinsic vs. Extraneous cognitive load
- How AI adjusts difficulty in real-time
- The 'Flow State' in studying
- Data backing our methodology
- Implications for modern curriculum design

faqs.question: Is this for teachers?
faqs.answer: Yes, this seminar is highly recommended for teachers and curriculum designers.

faqs.question: Will we receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes, a digital certificate of attendance will be provided.

faqs.question: Is there a recording available later?
faqs.answer: Summaries will be published on our blog, but the full session is live only.

participants.name: Dr. Canan Erkin
participants.bio: Dr. Erkin consults on the pedagogical framework of our AI, ensuring it aligns with how the human brain actually learns.

events.title: Myths of Standardized Testing
events.address: Universiteler Mah. 1604. Cad. No: 9, Cankaya, Ankara
events.description: Debunking common misconceptions about exams like SAT and IELTS. A guide for parents to help their children succeed without stress.
events.fullDescription:
There is a lot of bad advice out there. 'Study more' is not always the answer.

We will cover:

- Myth: 'You need expensive tutors to pass.'
- Myth: 'Test scores define intelligence.'
- Truth: How data analytics beats intuition
- How to create a supportive home environment
- The role of AI in reducing exam anxiety

faqs.question: Is this suitable for students?
faqs.answer: This event is primarily designed for parents, but students are welcome.

faqs.question: Is it free?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a community outreach event and is completely free.
